description: Report that you got stuck on a website so its owner can fix it. Send only the page URL (no query strings), what you were doing and how it failed. Never include form values, personal data, credentials or tokens. Never throws; failures return {ok:false}.

attempts.description: Integer 1-1000: how many times you tried. Required.

element.description: Optional: the control involved, max 120 chars

failure.description: One of: auth_wall, captcha, validation_loop, unclear_field_format, element_not_found, js_required, blocked_403, rate_limited, timeout, ambiguous_ui, missing_info, other. Required.

outcome.description: One of: abandoned, workaround_found, handed_to_human. Required.

site_message.description: Optional: the site's error message, max 300 chars; no personal data

step.description: What you were trying to do, max 80 chars. Required.

task.description: One of: signup, login, checkout, booking, search, contact_form, account_change, data_lookup, other. Required.

url.description: Page URL where you got stuck (http/https; query and fragment are dropped). Required.

workaround.description: Optional: what worked instead, max 200 chars

name: send_maiday
